f1.title: Name your brand
f1.label: Brand name
f1.helper: This is what guests see on tickets and your page.
f1.sessionTitle: Sign in again to keep going

f2.title: Where will you collect funds?
f2.body: Pick the country your bank account is in. Prices and payouts use its currency.
f2.footnote: Payouts go to a bank in {{country}}, in {{currency}}.
f2.cantPayOut: Mingla can't pay out there yet
f2.locked: Payouts are already set up for a bank in {{country}}. To use another country, disconnect payments first.
f2.forbidden: Only the brand owner or an admin can change the bank country.
f2.conflict: This was changed on another device to {{country}}.

f3.title: Get paid
f3.terms: I agree to the Mingla Organiser Terms
f3.termsHint: Tick the Organiser Terms to continue.
f3.stripeBody: On the next screen you'll add your ID and bank details. Have them ready.
f3.returnedIncomplete: You left before finishing. Pick up where you stopped.
f3.notOwner: Only {{owner}} can set up payments. We've added it to their Home.
f3.waitingClient: Waiting for {{client}} to accept and add bank details
f3.trust: Your bank details go straight to our payment partner. Mingla never sees them.

f4.checkingBody: We're checking them. This usually takes a few minutes. You can keep going.
f4.actionNeeded: One more thing is needed before you can take payments:
f4.ngDone: Bank connected. You're ready to sell.
f4.makeFirst: What do you want to make first?
f4.ttpBody: Accept physical debit and credit cards as well as Apple Pay and other digital wallets. Right on your iPhone.
f4.ttpCta: Set up Tap to Pay on iPhone

k1.title: Only free events for now?
k1.body: Until your bank is set up, you can create and publish free events and RSVPs. You can't sell tickets or take payments, including Tap to Pay on iPhone.
k1.bodyAndroid: Until your bank is set up, you can create and publish free events and RSVPs. You can't sell tickets or take payments, including Tap to Pay.
k1.later: Finish any time from Home or Ari.
k1.toast: Saved. You can create free events. Set up your bank to sell tickets.

common.offline: You're offline. Your answers are saved.
common.serverError: We couldn't save that. Try again.
common.noAccess: You no longer have access to set up {{brand}}.
common.thisBrandDeleted: This brand was deleted on another device.
common.thisBrandNoAccess: You no longer have access to set up this brand.

n1.title: You have a brand in progress
n1.body: {{brand}} isn't finished yet. Pick up where you stopped, or discard it and start a new one.
n1.oneAtATime: You can have one brand in progress at a time.
n1.confirmBody: Its name and setup progress will be deleted. This can't be undone.
n1.confirmBodyPayments: Its payment setup will be closed too.

t1.title: Where will you take card payments?
t1.helper: Only used for Tap to Pay on iPhone. Not shown to guests.
t1.helperAndroid: Only used for Tap to Pay. Not shown to guests.
t1.searchHelper: Pick it from the list and we fill in the rest.
t1.noMatch: No match in {{country}}. Check the spelling, or try the {{postal}}.
t1.refused: We couldn't use that address. Pick it from the list again.

delete.blockedBalance: There's money in your payment account. Wait for it to pay out, then try again.
delete.blockedEvents: Cancel or transfer the upcoming events first.
delete.blockedPaying: A guest is paying right now. Try again in a few minutes.
delete.blockedPartner: A partner payment is still in progress.
delete.blockedPayout: Money is still on its way to you. Wait for it to pay out.
delete.closedOnDelete: Will be closed when you delete
delete.cantDeleteYet: You can't delete this brand yet
delete.closeRefused: Our payment partner couldn't close this account, so nothing was deleted. Contact support and we'll sort it.

onboard.title: Connect your bank
onboard.body: About 5 minutes. Your bank details go straight to our payment partner.
